name: Web3 Icons Branded
about: Web3 Icons Branded is a free, open-source icon set with 4,171 icons designed by 0xa3k5. Ideal for login buttons, partner walls, tech-stack badges and social links - every logo is a clean vector. Every icon is available as SVG, PNG and WebP, or as a copy-paste React / TypeScript component or CDN link. Recolor and resize each one in the browser before you export – free, no account needed. Licensed under MIT.

faqs.q: Are Web3 Icons Branded free to use?
faqs.a: The icon files themselves are open source under the MIT license – free to download and use. But company logos are trademarks of their owners, so always check each brand's usage guidelines before commercial use.

faqs.q: Can I use Web3 Icons Branded logos in commercial projects?
faqs.a: You can freely download and embed the vector files under the MIT license, but trademark law still applies: don't imply endorsement by a brand, and follow each company's brand guidelines for clear-space, colors and minimum sizes.

faqs.q: How do I use Web3 Icons Branded in React or my website?
faqs.a: Copy any icon as a React / TypeScript component straight into your project, or paste the CDN link into your HTML. Every icon also downloads as SVG, PNG or WebP, and you can recolor and resize it in the browser before you export.

faqs.q: How many Web3 Icons Branded are there?
faqs.a: There are 4,171 icons in the Web3 Icons Branded set, designed by 0xa3k5. Use the search above to find any icon by name.

faqs.q: What formats are Web3 Icons Branded available in?
faqs.a: SVG, PNG and WebP downloads, copy-paste React / TypeScript components, plus a CDN link for every single icon – free, no account needed.
